tasks.label: Live Run in Popup Console
tasks.command: taskkill /f /im ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe >nul 2>&1 & g++ -std=c++17 -o ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe ${fileBasename} -fno-diagnostics-show-caret -fdiagnostics-color=always && echo. && echo --- Enter Inputs Below --- && ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe
